text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

While your history of ulcerative colitis and multiple sexual partners raises suspicion for viral hepatitis or cholangiocarcinoma, the combination of severe pruritus and fatigue without mention of fever or significant right upper quadrant pain is highly characteristic of PBC. We have already ordered the necessary labs, including Alkaline Phosphatase, Bilirubin, and viral serologies. Once results are back, I will confirm the diagnosis, likely looking for anti-mitochondrial antibodies (AMA) to support this clinical picture.
